name: gatsby-london
description: A custom, image-centric theme for Gatsby
author: Imed Adel <aadelimed@gmail.com>

scripts.deploy: gatsby clean && gatsby build --prefix-paths && gh-pages -d public -b master && gh-pages -d public -b pages -o codeberg
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run verify:build && npm run verify:fast

@graphql-tools/utils@<12.0.1.why: GHSA-7mx3-vvmw-hjmv (high): prototype pollution in mergeDeep, fixed in 12.0.1. Gatsby's @graphql-codegen/* and @graphql-tools/* deps pin ^8/^9.

gatsby > cookie.why: GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x (low): out-of-bounds characters accepted in cookie name/path/domain, fixed in 0.7.0. gatsby itself pins ^0.5.0 (scoped under gatsby because a top-level range override does not catch it).

immutable@<3.8.4.why: GHSA-wf6x-7x77-mvgw, GHSA-xvcm-6775-5m9r, GHSA-v56q-mh7h-f735 (high): prototype pollution / hash-collision DoS, fixed in 3.8.4. @ardatan/relay-compiler (via Gatsby's GraphQL codegen) pins ~3.7.6.
immutable@<3.8.4.dropWhen: @ardatan/relay-compiler (or whatever Gatsby uses instead) accepts immutable >=3.8.4.

lodash.why: GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc (high), GHSA-f23m-r3pf-42rh (moderate): code injection via _.template imports and related issues, fixed after 4.17.23. @graphql-codegen/plugin-helpers pins ~4.17.0, which can never reach 4.18.
lodash.dropWhen: Nothing in the tree pins lodash to ~4.17 (check `npm ls lodash` without the override).

path-to-regexp@<0.1.13.why: GHSA-37ch-88jc-xwx2 (high): ReDoS with multiple route params, fixed in 0.1.13. gatsby pins exactly 0.1.12.

postcss-selector-parser.why: GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf (moderate): quadratic-time selector parsing, fixed in 7.1.6. cssnano 6 plugins, postcss-modules-* and postcss-calc (via Gatsby's CSS pipeline) still declare ^6.
postcss-selector-parser.dropWhen: Gatsby's cssnano / css-loader chain accepts postcss-selector-parser >=7.1.6.

serialize-javascript.why: GHSA-5c6j-r48x-rmvq (high, RCE), GHSA-qj8w-gfj5-8c6v (moderate), fixed in 7.0.5. css-minimizer-webpack-plugin@2 (pinned by gatsby) declares ^5.0.1.

sharp.why: GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj, GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c, GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w (high): bundled libvips CVEs, fixed in 0.35.5. gatsby-plugin-sharp, gatsby-sharp, gatsby-transformer-sharp and gatsby-plugin-manifest pin ^0.32.6.
sharp.dropWhen: The gatsby sharp plugins depend on sharp >=0.35.5.

tmp.why: GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65 (high), GHSA-52f5-9888-hmc6 (low): symlink-based arbitrary file write, fixed in 0.2.6. external-editor (via gatsby-cli > yurnalist > inquirer@7) pins ^0.0.33.
tmp.dropWhen: gatsby-cli no longer pulls in external-editor with tmp <0.2.6.

uuid@<11.1.1.why: GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (moderate): missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6, fixed in 11.1.1. gatsby pins ^8.3.2. uuid 11 still ships CommonJS; 12+ is ESM-only, so do not widen this.

webpack.why: GHSA-8fgc-7cc6-rx7x, GHSA-38r7-794h-5758 (low): buildHttp allowedUris bypass, fixed after 5.104.0. gatsby pins ~5.98.0.

webpack-dev-middleware.why: GHSA-g84c-rxfj-3j2c (high): path traversal via non-slash-terminated publicPath, fixed in 7.4.5. gatsby pins ^5.3.4. Only used by `gatsby develop`.
